**Obligations of the Supplier:**
* Keep all information received within the engagement secret (L48, L58, L68, L78, L86).
* Appoint one customer manager to coordinate communication with the client (L51, L61, L91).
* Perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a report on the visit (L52, L62, L72, L80, L82).
* Maintain an available spare parts inventory for servicing the plant in Kiryat Gat (L54, L64, L74, L84, L94).
* Supplier's technician shall arrive at the warehouse in Ashdod within four hours for an urgent call, and within two days for a regular call (L56, L66, L86).
* Insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party insurance (L57, L67, L77).
* Coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the plant in Kiryat Gat that requires a shutdown (L59, L69, L79, L89).

**Obligations of the Client (המזמין):**
* Pay the consideration within 45 days from the date of receiving a lawful tax invoice (L53, L63, L73, L83, L93).
* Inspect the quality of service at any time, upon prior coordination (L50, L70, L80, L90).

**Fines (Cases and Amounts):**
* Failure to perform preventative maintenance on time at the branch in Haifa: 15,000 NIS per case (L49).
* Working without a valid entry permit at the warehouse in Ashdod: 16,750 NIS per case (L55).
* Failure to document a service call in the system at the logistics center in Holon: 18,500 NIS per case (L60).
* Delay in the supply of spare parts: 5% of the order value per week of delay (L65).
* Delay in responding to an urgent service call at the plant in Kiryat Gat: 22,000 NIS per case (L71).
* Failure to meet the repair times determined in the service appendix at the branch in Haifa: 23,750 NIS per case (L76).
* Shutdown of the cooling system beyond four hours at the warehouse in Ashdod: 1,500 NIS per case (L81).
* Failure to submit the monthly maintenance report on time at the logistics center in Holon: 3,250 NIS per case (L87).
* Replacing a technician without prior notice at the offices in Tel Aviv: 5,000 NIS per case (L92).
